اغتفرتن (form VIII)
# اِغْتَفَرْتُنَّ (iḡtafartunna) /iɣ.ta.far.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
# اُغْتُفِرْتُنَّ (uḡtufirtunna) /uɣ.tu.fir.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
